name: Cinematic Flight — One Test Email to Draft

parameters.content:
## One designated test email → an unsent draft
Manual only. Searches INBOX for **CF-AI-TEST-001**, requires exactly one exact result, then fetches only its plain text.

Only the agreed fictional test sentences are sent to NVIDIA. Email addresses, signature text and attachments are not passed to the model. No sender, delete, flag update, webhook, approval storage or Studio write exists.

Re-running produces another draft/model call. This is not an inbox watcher or production queue. If no match, multiple matches or unexpected text is found, it stops.
